scopeLimitations: All sixteen current final frames were actually reviewed through four original2x-nearest row strips, with all four raw native groups and selected source also personally opened.
Current V2 portrait is an internal original-project authority, not external franchise proof. Hidden reverse construction and tiny scroll writing remain interpreted; no absolute1:1 certification.
Anatomical RIGHT katana and LEFT scroll relationship is assessed from each turned torso, rather than from viewer position. All poses retain opaque long source kimono and platform boots.

Independent replay reconstructs raw whole-component vectors, all bounded weak-alpha fringes, all sixteen whole RGBA crops, translation-only assembly, then standard common-nearest normalization. Every1837807alpha>12 source pixel is assigned; no endpoint is repaired through padding.
